singularity.remediation: Implement a single authoritative-copy mechanism — token-based registry or designated system of record per MLETR Art. 10.

control.remediation: Establish exclusive control via cryptographic key assignment (not shared-platform access) per MLETR Art. 11.

integrity.article: MLETR Art. 10 — integrity of the electronic record

reliability.article: MLETR Art. 12 — reliability of the issuing system
reliability.remediation: Upgrade to a qualified trust service or platform-attested reliability standard per MLETR Art. 12.

output_example.governing_law_recommendation: Weak corridor — specify UK, Singapore, or UAE governing law and ensure the eBL terms expressly incorporate MLETR-equivalent requirements. Paper fallback may be required.
